definitions: A male given name of Kazakh and Arabic origin.
The former name of Astana, the capital city of Kazakhstan, from 2019 to 2022.
Nursultan Nazarbayev (born 1940), a Kazakh politician who served as the first President of Kazakhstan from 1990 to 2019.
examples: Nursultan is a common name in Kazakhstan.
The city of Nursultan was renamed Astana in 2022.
Nursultan Nazarbayev played a key role in the country's independence.
